data.message: I propose a 10-ton monthly cap per fisher. If all 25 follow it, total catch is 250 tons, each earns $10,000, and the remaining 250 guarantees restoration to 500 even under the weaker replenishment outcome. This maximizes equal catches while guaranteeing a full lake next month. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support; please state whether you support it.
